Evidence: Semantic evasion, Jan 6 violence, oversight independence.
#DOJ #Jan6 #Politics

The reality is a deliberate attempt to reframe a violent disruption of democratic processes to align with political narratives, undermining the IG's role. Resulting Judgement: (-1.5, -1.5) — Greater Evil

The nominee's refusal to acknowledge the nature of the event signals a subversion of the oversight role's independence.
The nominee is being questioned by the Senate on his fitness for the DOJ inspector general role, a position designed to provide independent oversight of the department.

The error is in the Plane of Lyrical (WHY). The nominee's narrative is an obfuscation of the event's nature to avoid political friction, failing the honesty test.

This is a test of institutional capture. By refusing to use the word 'attack,' the nominee signals to his political patrons that he will manage the DOJ's oversight through a partisan lens.
